judge_claim: The protocol's estimation error under state-preparation-and-measurement (SPAM) errors is bounded as ||delta g_SPAM||_2 <= (L_C/sigma_min(K)) ||delta beta||_2, where L_C is a Lipschitz constant and sigma_min(K) the smallest singular value of the Gram-like matrix K (Section 3.6, Eq. 43).

domain.measurement_design: combined Algorithm 1 Chebyshev-radius and angular response matrix K
domain.spam_model: independent complex displacement miscalibration at each measurement point; RPE statistical noise excluded from delta g_SPAM

exact_statement_tested: For every displacement perturbation whose line segment remains in the certified disk, ||K^+[C(beta+delta)-C(beta)]||_2 <= (L_C/sigma_min(K))||delta||_2.
proof_obligation: Derive the exact D-RUT polynomial C, its Cartesian gradient grad C=h+Hz, certify L_C=||h||_2+||H||_2*0.70, use the actual full-rank Algorithm 1 design K, and apply the mean-value and pseudoinverse operator-norm inequalities.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if the universal algebraic certificate, faithful finite-Fock response checks, all predeclared perturbation tests, independent checker, and negative control pass; otherwise BLOCKED.
scope_limit: This verifies displacement-miscalibration SPAM as defined in Section 3.6. It does not cover arbitrary state-preparation or readout channels, and it keeps the paper's separately analyzed RPE noise outside delta g_SPAM.
